rule: A standard Key enters its free body with a real store-force guard when required. It marks its body before recursive value retirement, processes Maps by stored per-Key registration rank and detaches only the selected entry before its value decrement. DETACHED(Map,Key) pairs retain entry-specific progress without clearing other Key associations. The value slot position counts surviving owning entries, preserving nonadjacent duplicate ordering; direct scalar or already-detached slots contribute no edge. The shared ordered-release fold preserves ALIAS wrapper/payload separation. Key fields wait until all notifications succeed; an earlier fatal retains later entries and Key fields. Later Map free sees only remaining owning edges. Callable/source checks still use full S and final S keeps its last ownership-valid snapshot.
engine_basis: Pinned Zend/zend_objects.c zend_object_std_dtor notifies weak observers before dynamic/declared fields. Zend/zend_weakrefs.c zend_weakrefs_notify and zend_weakref_unref visit registrations in insertion order; zend_weakref_unref_single deletes one selected bucket through zend_hash_index_del before its owning value is destroyed. Zend/zend_hash.c marks the bucket undefined before pDestructor. The reverse object-store free adds its C pin before free_obj. GC31 Map free still unregisters all keys before values.
